name: Ride-By Recovery

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Trigger Your mount moves within reach of an unattended item of 1 Bulk or less.

Requirements You're mounted.

---
As you race past, you kick a fallen spear or other item up off the ground. You Interact to either pick the item up or bounce it off the ground into a sheath or other container on your person. You don't need a free hand to do the latter.
